title: Architecture Course Redeploy Readiness
description: Get the architecture course website and its proctor server running end to end and ready to be redeployed: bootstrap the host, run every course, renderer and proctor suite, build the site, run the dev stack and the end-to-end gate, and fix every defect found on the way.
summary: Site and proctor build, pass unit tests, typecheck, check and the end-to-end gate in dev and release-rehearsal topologies (87 tests each); release site artifact staged (88 files). Fixed the e2e gate's browser install policy and Playwright scope, pet pick-up on the overview, the assignment PDF budget, FixedCommandPage storage demand, stale kernel tests, build-library type errors and the print test re-export edge. Docker image and release workflow remain Linux-only; legal notice content is an owner decision. See readiness-report.md.
